source: Gmsh 4.15.2 (pip wheel, used outside the repository): gmsh.model.mesh.getElementProperties reference coordinates for orders 1-6, and for prisms of order 3-6 (getElementProperties fails) the node order of a straight prism meshed with gmsh.model.mesh.setOrder. Gmsh reference elements: line/quad/hex [-1, 1]^d, simplices unit, prism unit triangle x [-1, 1], pyramid base [-1, 1]^2 apex (0, 0, 1).
